summary: CI workflow running build+test on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest (matrix added in #159, after ubuntu-only CI hid months of Windows-only bugs), Node 20.x. Requires an explicit top-level `permissions: contents: read` block — its absence trips CodeQL's actions/missing-workflow-permissions check. CI has NO embedding model, so every real-model embedder test (tests/embedder-daemon.test.ts lifecycle + query lane, tests/embed-runtime.test.ts) SKIPS here on both OSes; the 'Embedder native smoke' step (scripts/embedder-native-smoke.mjs, after npm ci) is the only CI check that onnxruntime-node and tokenizers installed and load on each OS, with the tokenizer files cached under runner.temp/coldstart-models keyed by OS + model REVISION. Triggers: pull_request and pushes to main — commits on a PR branch that were never pushed have never run here (the vector store's first Windows run came only when steps 0-2 were pushed, 2026-11-22).
